sql-joining-tables.prompt: Show each student's name next to the subjects they're enrolled in, using the students and enrollments tables. Sort by name.
sql-joining-tables.starter_code:

FROM students
-- Join enrollments, then sort by name
;
sql-joining-tables.sample_answer:

FROM students
JOIN enrollments ON students.id = enrollments.student_id
